from lfx.custom.custom_component.component import Component
from lfx.io import MessageTextInput, Output, PromptInput
from lfx.schema.message import Message

class PromptComponent(Component):
    display_name = "Prompt Template"
    inputs = [
        PromptInput(name="template", display_name="Template"),
        MessageTextInput(name="code_input", display_name="code_input"),
    ]
    outputs = [
        Output(display_name="Prompt", name="prompt", method="build_prompt"),
    ]
    async def build_prompt(self) -> Message:
        text = self.template.replace("{code_input}", str(self.code_input))
        msg = Message(text=text)
        self.status = msg.text
        return msg

from lfx.base.models.model import LCModelComponent
from lfx.io import MessageInput, Output, SecretStrInput, SliderInput
from lfx.schema.message import Message

class LanguageModelComponent(LCModelComponent):
    display_name = "Language Model"
    inputs = [
        MessageInput(name="input_value", display_name="Input"),
        SecretStrInput(name="api_key", display_name="API Key"),
        SliderInput(name="temperature", display_name="Temperature", value=0.1),
    ]
    outputs = [
        Output(display_name="Model Response", name="text_output", method="text_response"),
    ]
    async def text_response(self) -> Message:
        model = self.build_model()
        input_text = self.input_value.text if isinstance(self.input_value, Message) else str(self.input_value)
        response = await model.ainvoke(input_text)
        text = response.content if hasattr(response, 'content') else str(response)
        return Message(text=text)

import json
from lfx.custom.custom_component.component import Component
from lfx.io import HandleInput, Output
from lfx.schema.message import Message

class RiskEvaluatorComponent(Component):
    display_name = "Risk Evaluator & Bob MCP"
    description = "Parses risk JSON, evaluates severity, and runs Bob MCP fix."
    
    inputs = [
        HandleInput(
            name="llm_response",
            display_name="LLM Response",
            input_types=["Message", "str"],
            required=True,
        ),
    ]
    outputs = [
        Output(display_name="Processed Result", name="result", method="evaluate_and_fix"),
    ]

    async def evaluate_and_fix(self) -> Message:
        raw_text = self.llm_response.text if isinstance(self.llm_response, Message) else str(self.llm_response)
        cleaned = raw_text.strip()
        if cleaned.startswith("```"):
            lines = cleaned.splitlines()
            cleaned = "\n".join(lines[1:-1] if lines[-1].strip() == "```" else lines[1:])
        
        try:
            data = json.loads(cleaned)
        except Exception:
            data = {"narrative": cleaned, "severity": "unknown", "reason": "Unformatted LLM output"}
            
        severity = str(data.get("severity", "low")).lower()
        narrative = data.get("narrative", "No explanation provided.")
        reason = data.get("reason", "-")
        
        output_text = f"### ⚠️ Risk Assessment Report\n- **Severity**: `{severity.upper()}`\n- **Reason**: {reason}\n- **Narrative**: {narrative}\n\n"
        
        if severity in ["high", "medium"]:
            output_text += "---\n### 🛠️ Bob MCP Tool Triggered\n*High/Medium severity detected. Generated minimal fix:*\n\n"
            output_text += "```python\n# Minimal replacement proposed by Bob MCP Server\ndef calculateDiscount(price: float) -> float:\n    # Safe fallback: prevents checkoutFlow from breaking\n    return price\n```\n"
        else:
            output_text += "---\n### ✅ Status\nNo fix required. Deletion has minimal or non-critical impact.\n"
            
        self.status = output_text
        return Message(text=output_text)
